history.summary: 1,216 sqft 4BR at Bellewaters, a 651-unit Sengkang EC (TOP 2017, 99yr from 2013) priced at $1,439 psf — right at the project's ~$1,467 psf 12-month resale average. Privatising EC in D19 with strong recent momentum (+6.9% y-o-y, +23.9% since 2022 per market data), liquid $1.75M family quantum.
history.rating_rationale: Web-verified: Bellewaters is a large 651-unit EC transacting at avg ~$1,467 psf over the last 12 months, so this $1,439 psf listing is fairly-to-keenly priced. EC fundamentals are favourable — entry priced below comparable private condos, strong +6.9% y-o-y / +23.9% since-2022 appreciation, and a liquid $1.75M 4BR family quantum well within the deep-buyer band. 320m to Farmway LRT (Sengkang LRT loop, two stops to Sengkang NEL/town centre). Score 644, on frontier. Dossier had null URA data; web research fills the gap.
red_flags: LRT (Farmway) not heavy-rail MRT — connectivity one notch below an MRT-adjacent project
99yr from 2013 leasehold; EC resale demand softens once novelty of privatisation passes
catalysts: EC-to-private appreciation runway as MOP/privatisation matures
Punggol Digital District and CRL Sengkang-area growth in D19
